name: Project completion projection refresh

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  refresh:
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.head_ref == 'chore/github-project-completion-automation'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out completion branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Remove one-shot workflow before projection
        run: git rm .github/workflows/project-completion-refresh.yml

      - name: Refresh deterministic EOS trace projection
        run: python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write

      - name: Refresh deterministic machine documentation
        run: python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Verify refreshed projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/test-github-project-metadata.py

      - name: Publish converged tree to temporary branch
        run: |
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'chore(github): converge generated project projections'
          git push --force origin HEAD:refs/heads/automation/project-completion-converged
